experiment_scenarios.name: Baseline Integration Test
experiment_scenarios.description: Baseline test of all brain systems integration
expected_outcomes: All memory systems (working, episodic, associative) should integrate with neural processing
Neuromodulators (dopamine, curiosity, novelty, prediction error) should integrate with action selection
Prediction systems (forward, value, behavioral, meta) should integrate with sensory processing
Cognition systems (concept formation, attention, planning, self-model) should integrate with episodic memory
Development systems (plasticity, critical periods, structural changes) should integrate with learning processes
Cross-system workflows (complete brain loop, memory-development interaction) should function properly

experiment_scenarios.name: Memory System Focus
test_phases: Phase 1: Working memory with neural processing
Phase 2: Episodic memory with brain regions
Phase 3: Associative memory with concepts
Phase 4: Memory consolidation across brain regions
expected_outcomes: Working memory should maintain neural activity patterns
Episodic memory should link experiences across brain regions
Associative memory should enable pattern completion
Memory consolidation should transfer memories between systems

experiment_scenarios.name: Neuromodulation System Focus
test_phases: Phase 1: Dopamine integration with working memory
Phase 2: Curiosity integration with episodic memory
Phase 3: Novelty integration with prediction systems
Phase 4: Prediction error integration with action selection
expected_outcomes: Dopamine should modulate working memory plasticity
Curiosity should drive exploration behavior
Novelty should enhance prediction learning
Prediction error should guide action selection

experiment_scenarios.name: Prediction System Focus
test_phases: Phase 1: Forward prediction with sensory processing
Phase 2: Value prediction with reward systems
Phase 3: Behavioral prediction with motor systems
Phase 4: Meta-prediction with cognitive systems
expected_outcomes: Forward prediction should integrate with sensory processing
Value prediction should integrate with reward systems
Behavioral prediction should integrate with motor output
Meta-prediction should integrate with cognitive evaluation

experiment_scenarios.name: Cognition System Focus
test_phases: Phase 1: Concept formation with episodic memory
Phase 2: Attention selection with prediction systems
Phase 3: Planning with action selection
Phase 4: Self-model with social learning
expected_outcomes: Concept formation should use episodic memory
Attention selection should use prediction errors
Planning should constrain action selection
Self-model should integrate with social learning

experiment_scenarios.name: Development System Focus
test_phases: Phase 1: Plasticity maturation with memory systems
Phase 2: Critical period effects with learning
Phase 3: Structural plasticity with neural processing
Phase 4: Adaptive development across systems
expected_outcomes: Plasticity maturation should affect memory systems
Critical periods should enhance learning
Structural plasticity should modify neural connectivity
Adaptive development should optimize system performance

experiment_scenarios.name: Cross-System Workflow Focus
test_phases: Phase 1: Complete brain loop integration
Phase 2: Memory consolidation during development
Phase 3: Neuromodulation-driven learning
Phase 4: Prediction with behavioral adaptation
expected_outcomes: Complete brain loop should function properly
